name: 🥘 Cozy Cabin Chili
what: A thick, beefy one-pot chili with beans and tomatoes, topped with cheese.

core.name: Chili beans (2 cans)
core.out: any canned beans, plus 1 more tsp chili powder

core.name: Canned diced tomatoes (big can)
core.out: a jar of marinara or salsa

core.name: Onion
core.out: skip it, or a little onion powder

extras: garlic, cheddar, sour cream, tomato paste or ketchup, brown sugar

moves.text: Pull the must-haves onto the counter. Dice the onion.
Brown the beef in a big pot. Leave it alone 4 minutes, then crumble. Add the onion until soft.
Stir in the spices for 1 minute until it smells toasty.
Add the tomatoes, the beans with their sauce and ½ cup water. Simmer uncovered until thick.
Taste and add salt. Top with cheese and sour cream.

key: Toast the spices in the pot for a minute before the liquid goes in.
done: It's thick, not soupy, and the beef has no pink.
plan_b: Short on time? Simmer 10 minutes and serve it over rice or chips.
